summary: Clarivate PLC filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 14, 2026. Shareholders voted on three proposals: election of directors (all nominees elected), advisory approval of executive compensation (approved), and ratification of PwC as auditor (approved). No material corporate actions or structural changes were announced. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting report with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes.
